generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Name, Address of contractor, Phone number, E-Mail address and registration copy etc should be submitted online

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The proposed methodology and program of construction backed with equipment, materials and manpower planning and deployment, duly supported with broad calculations including Environmental Management Plan and Quality Assurance Plan with quality control procedures proposed to be adopted, justifying their capability of execution and completion of the work as per technical specifications within the stipulated period of completion as per milestones.
The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of KPP Portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches.
Conditional tenders will be rejected
The tender processing fee will neither be refunded nor will be transferred to other works
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Government orders

Contractor has to make his own arrangement for procurement of all materials required for the work. There is no departmental supply of materials. Contractor should procure only ISI mark materials and submit necessary quality control certificates from the authorised quality control authority, before execution
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval
The work includes all lead and lift and work shall be carried out as per the instructions of the Engineer-in-Charge of the work

If CNNL wishes to engage third party inspecting agency for the said work, apart from the Quality Control authorities and field tests of the Nigama and Contractor, then the contractor should co-operate with the third party test and Quality Control authorities
Any necessary documents can be uploaded in spaces provided for general documents in upload document section
The successful bidder whose tender is approved, should fulfill all the conditions stipulated in tender document and enter into agreement with Nigama in stipulated time
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs
The Bidder shall ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of KPPP on or before the last date of bid submission

EMD and Tender processing fee shall be paid through e-Payment using the following four modes of Payment: a. Credit card payment, b. Direct debit payment, c. National electronic fund transfer, d. Over the Counter (OTC)
The bidder should be abided to all the terms and conditions laid down in approved tender bid document

technicalCriterionList.description: A minimum number of one similar contracts Rehabilitation and Improvement works to Dams including under water grouting and pointing. that have been satisfactorily and substantially completed as a prime contractor, joint venture member , between 1st April, 2019 and bid submission deadline:(1)ONE contract, each of minimum value 1079.04 Lakhs (80% of the Estimated Value) Or (2)TWO contracts, each of minimum value 809.28 Lakhs (60% of the Estimated Value) Or (3)THREE contracts, each of minimum value 539.52 lakhs (40% of the Estimated Value)

For the above and any other contracts (substantially completed and under implementation) as prime contractor, joint venture member between 2019-20 to 2025-26 a minimum construction experience in the following key activities successfully completed in last 7 years 1.Drilling core hole in hard rock : 4148.82 Rmt, 2.Grouting to dam body : 647.29 Tonne, 3.Under water pointing : 2301.11 Sqm, 4.Above water pointing : 2001.29 Sqm
Experience under construction contracts such as Rehabilitation and Improvement works to Dams including under water grouting and pointing. for at least the last seven years, starting 1st April 2019

The Bidder shall demonstrate that it has access to, or has available, liquid assets, unencumbered real assets, lines of credit, and other financial means (independent of any contractual advance payment) sufficient to meet the construction cash flow requirements estimated as Rs. 337.20 Lakhs about 3 months cash flow at peak construction period) for the subject contract(s) net of the Bidders other commitments

The Bidder shall provide details of the Key Personnel and such other Key Personnel that the Bidder considers appropriate, together with their academic qualifications and work experience. The Bidder shall complete the relevant Forms in Section-4, Bidding Forms. The key personnel requirement is as per qualification criteria of Section-3 Key personnel (1) Construction Manager-1 No BE (Civil)-10 Years Experience (2) Site engineer-1 No BE (Civil)-5 Years Experience (3) Quality Control Engineer-1 No BE (Civil)-3 Years Experience (4) Grouting Specialist-1 No BE (Civil)-10 Years Experience, (5) Surveyer -1 No Diploma (Civil)-3 Years Experience (6)Safety, Environment & Social Expert (Need Based)-1 No BECivil/Graduate in Environment/ health-1 Year Experience (7)Divers- 2 Persons

Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded. The Bidder must demonstrate that it will have access to the key ontractors equipment listed as per qualification criteria section-4 Equipment in the bid document (1) Pneumatic Grout Pump-2Nos (1-Own & 1-Lease/Rent) (2) Screw Compressor-2Nos (1-Own & 1-Lease/Rent) (3) Diesel Generator min 30 KVA-1No (1-Own) (4) Diving Helmet KMB-3units (1-Own & 2-Lease/Rent) (5) Underwater ROV-1No Own (6) Pnemumatic Chipping machine-3Nos (1-Own & 2-Lease/Rent) (7) Pnemumatic Drilling machine-2Nos (1-Own & 1-Lease/Rent) (8) Electrical Winch machine-2Nos (1-Own & 1-Lease/Rent)

technicalCriterionList.description: Bidders who meet the minimum qualification criteria will be qualified only if their available bid capacity for construction work is equal to or more than the total bid value of the work. The available bid capacity will be calculated as under: Assessed Available bid capacity (AxNx1.15-B) Where, A-Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last seven years (updated to the price level of the financial year 2026-27 at the rate of 5% per year), taking into account the completed as well as works in progress). NNumber of years prescribed for completion of the works for which bids are invited (period upto 6 months to be taken as half-year and more than 6 months as one year). B-Value, at the current price level, of existing commitments on on-going works to be completed during the period of completion of the works for which bids are invited

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Rehabilitation and Improvement works to Nugu Dam under World Bank aided DRIP Phase II. (Package-1)

itemList.description: Raking, cleaning and pointing of masonry joints on upstream face of dam with UV resistant, high strength and anti-shrink materials using Crystalline Technology(CT)/ Poly Ironite Ceramic Cementitious/ Equivalent Technology, using Cementitious materials conforming to BIS/EN-1504-3, Class R4(2014) standards for masonry joint filling to a depth of 5 cm including preparing of ‘T’ joint of masonry by removing of existing loose portion of stone masonry by breaking (using manual / mechanical means ) removing existing embedded M.S. bar, racking out the masonry joints to required depth, cleaning with special chemicals and air water jet under pressure for removing algae/ fungi, applying bond coat before repair material application and top coat after finishing, complete as per specification. including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.

Providing cementitious 1:3 mortar with anti-shrink admixtures for filling of big cavities in the masonry joint upto 30 cm depth complete as per specification including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, scaffolding, hire charges of cranes, insurance charges transportation including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.

Providing & applying of horizontal grouting through inserted pipes on the upstream face of the masonry dam with Poly Ceramic Cementitious materials with non-shrink admixtures as per site using grouting pump, mixer etc and all relevant safety with all leads and lifts etc. complete as per specification and including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge

Providing and applying non-shrink, UV resistant lime surkhi mortar / heritage mortar of pasty consistancy to build up downstream surface to a thickness of 10 mm on the existing surface of down stream, including filling honey combing area, including breaking honeycomb area, (using manual/mechanical means), power tool cleaning, clean with special chemical steripure 100 with pressure water jet for removing of algae fungi complete as per specification including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, scaffolding, hire charges of cranes, insurance charges transportation with all leads and lifts and any other incidental charges as directed by the Engineer in charge

Raking, cleaning and pointing of masonry joints on upstream face dam with UV resistant and anti-shrink materials using crystalline technology(CT)/Polymer/Equivalent Technology, using cementitious materials conforming to BIS/EN-1504-3, Class R4(2014) standards along with quick setting and rapid hardening admixtures / Rapid setting mortar / epoxy based putty for masonry joint filling to a depth of 5 cm to 15 cm including preparing of flush pointing of masonry by removing of existing loose portion of stone masonry by breaking (using manual / mechanical means ) removing existing embedded M.S. bar, racking out the masonry joints to required depth, cleaning with specialchemicals and air water jet under pressure for removing algae/ fungi, applying bond coat before repair material application and top coat after finishing, complete as per specification including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, scaffolding, hire charges of cranes, insurance charges transportation including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. (Below water)

Pack grout filling the internal porous cavities greater than depth of 15cm in the RR masonry: Treating the internal cavities greater than a depth 15 cm deep in the masonry using injection pressure grouting to reduce the porosity of the masonry by drilling hole of 12.5 mm/25mm dia. and 200mm deep and fixing PVC nozzles in triangular pattern. Minimum 3 nos. of PVC nozzles shall be fixed per 1m2 of the upstream area for grouting. Grouting the deep cavities inside the masonry joint using Polycementitious materials or equivalent having High strength, quick setting and zero shrink cementitious grout/ along with plasticized, expanding-non shrink grout admixture under required consistency by using 40 psi grouting pump. The grouting material shall give a minimum compressive strength of 35N/mm2 in 28 days when cube tested. All works Complete using all relevant safety equipment’s with all lead and lifts complete as per specification including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, electricity, scaffolding, hanging platform, pulleys ,hire charges of cranes, curing, all relevant safety equipment’s, insurance charges, transportation with including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.Work will be measured and paid based on weight of cement and cementitious mixture (without water) used (Below water)

underwater HD video filming of cracks, cavities and other treated areas, the work also including of colour video monitoring wherever directed including covering all activities / raking to the required depth, cleaning of joints by brushing using pneumatic tools and underwater video camera monitoring unit with TV set for desplay at top during execution after completion of the pointing and injection grouting and other repair works in the upstream area of dam including supply of soft copy of video and hard copy of mapped area and report of the interpretation of various surface defects etc. (chainage wise) complete as per direction of the engineer in charge

Drilling 150 mm dia core holes from top of dam in the dam body and up to in foundation, using diamond core bit vertical / inclined at 50-100 to vertical as directed including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, water charges, collection of core samples, logging and labelling samples, supplying honne wood corebox including cement grouting and redrilling in case of collapse of sides (excluding cost of cement for grouting) etc., complete including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. ( For Assesing the quality of masonry and determining propertys required for stabality analysis) for depth upto 30 m depth

Drilling 150 mm dia core holes from top of dam in the dam body and up to in foundation, using diamond core bit vertical / inclined at 50-100 to vertical as directed including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, water charges, collection of core samples, logging and labelling samples, supplying honne wood corebox including cement grouting and redrilling in case of collapse of sides (excluding cost of cement for grouting) etc., complete including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. ( For Assesing the quality of masonry and determining propertys required for stabality analysis) 30 to 50 m depth

Flushing grout holes of all sizes with water and air jets alternatively for an average period of 30 minutes and observing water intake after flushing including cost of all materials, machinery, labour etc.,complete including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge

Carrying out Borehole Videography of the predrilled boreholes of 150mm dia and upto a depth of 40m from the dam top with Digital all weather camera with LED, recorders, cables, extention rods, clamps, brackets etc including providing the result in soft copy in CD or pen drive 3 sets. Videography shall record all internal cracks and visible fissures, deformities with live recording complete including all leads and lifts of all materials and as per drawing, specifications, complete including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge.

Conducting percolation test in the drill holes at the desired presure including water supply arrangements and necessory accessories etc. complete including all lead and lifts of all materials and as per drawing, specifications and including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge up to 10m depth.

Drilling 47 mm dia ( BX ) core hole in hard rock using diamond core bit vertical / inclined upto 10 degree to vertical as directed including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, water charges, collection of core samples, logging and labelling samples, supplying honne wood core box including cement grouting and redrilling in case of collapse of sides ( excluding cost of cement for grouting ) with all other ancillary operations and all other ancillary operations complete for depth upto 30 m from surface. including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge Primary, Secondary & tertiary holes for depth upto 30 m depth

Drilling 47 mm dia ( BX ) core hole in hard rock using diamond core bit vertical / inclined upto 10 degree to vertical as directed including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, water charges, collection of core samples, logging and labelling samples, supplying honne wood core box including cement grouting and redrilling in case of collapse of sides ( excluding cost of cement for grouting ) with all other ancillary operations and all other ancillary operations complete for depth upto 30 m from surface. including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge Primary, Secondary & tertiary holes Beyond 30 m up to 50 m depth

Grouting in stages of 6 m each after carrying out the water loss test through the dam body of Nugu dam indicating large voids and cavities due to loss of binding material & because of wide openings of upstream masonry joints grout used shall be a colloidal mixture of 53 grade cement(OPC) mixed with non-shrink admixtures at limited grout pressure by using heavy duty , variable discharge pressure positive displacement grout pump screw rotor type and high speed mechanized colloidal mixture with separate sludge / holding tanks . Fitting of mechanical or inflatable grouting packers with nozzle and recording and control of pressure and consumption of grout as per direction of Engineer in Charge. Including Washing and flushing the holes with alternate water and air jets. For Investigation, Testing, Primary, Secondary & tertiary holes including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer in Charge

Drilling test holes, to check the permeability, of 76 mm dia ( NX ) core hole in dam body using diamond core bit vertical / inclined at 50-100 to vertical as directed including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, water charges, collection of core samples, logging and labelling samples, supplying honne wood core box including cement grouting and redrilling in case of collapse of sides ( excluding cost of cement for grouting ) etc., complete including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. for depth upto 30 m depth

Drilling test holes, to check the permeability, of 76 mm dia ( NX ) core hole in dam body using diamond core bit vertical / inclined at 50-100 to vertical as directed including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, water charges, collection of core samples, logging and labelling samples, supplying honne wood core box including cement grouting and redrilling in case of collapse of sides ( excluding cost of cement for grouting ) etc., complete including leads and lifts as directed by the Engineer-in-Charge. Beyond 30 m up to 50 m depth

Underwater Videography of the upstream face of masonry dam using ROV to identify cavity, damages, deterioration of construction materials. The area to be inspected is below the water level to the river bed. Complete videography of dam wall to be submitted as DVD/Pendrive, report and recommendations to be submitted in hard copy. Live Streaming of videos to surface captured by ROV, User-friendly Software Report with Position/Geo Tagging of areas of damages with easy features etc., complete with all lead and lifts and as directed by the Engineer in charge
